## Changes

## Bug fixes
- Contours could be calculated for the wrong area, so after Update they did not appear on the sheet. Right after switching between plan and section views (as Update › All views does), the calculation took its area from the previous view's sheet framing, or from the whole editor view. Each view is now calculated over its own sheet area. If a plan looks empty after an earlier update, Update it once more.
- Receptor numbers were missing from section views on the sheet and in exports. Each receptor on or near the section line now shows its number, on every floor of a stack, as in plan.
